$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file (enables autocompletion).

preset.description: Start from a preset: casual, realistic, workweek or intense.

from.description: First day to fill: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY, today, yesterday or relative (30d, 12w, 6m, 1y). Default: 1y.

to.description: Last day to fill (same formats as `from`). Default: today.

year.description: Fill a whole calendar year (shortcut for from/to).

allowFuture.description: Allow dates after today. Default: false.

commits.description: Commits per active day: a number (5) or a random range ("1-10"). Default: 1-5.

distribution.description: How amounts are drawn from the range: uniform, normal (bell curve) or skewed (mostly low, natural looking). Default: uniform.

frequency.description: Percentage of eligible days that get commits (0-100). Default: 100.

days.description: Days of the week: all, weekdays, weekends, a list (mon,wed,fri) or a range (mon-fri). Default: all.

weights.description: Relative chance per day of the week, e.g. { "sat": 0.3, "sun": 0.2 }.

fill.description: all: fill every selected day · gaps: only days without contributions · top-up: add only what's missing to reach the target. Default: all.

maxCommits.description: Safety limit for the total number of commits. Default: 50000.

seed.description: Seed for the random choices; the same seed reproduces the same plan.

time.description: Local time window for commits, HH:MM-HH:MM. Default: 09:00-21:00.

timezone.description: IANA time zone (Europe/Madrid), UTC or an offset (+05:30). Default: the system's.

text.description: Write this text on the contribution graph.

pattern.description: Path to a pattern file to draw on the graph (up to 7 lines).

intensity.description: Commits for the darkest squares of a drawing. Default: 12.

messagesFile.description: Text file with one message (template) per line, picked at random.

authorName.description: Commit author name. Default: your GitHub name.

authorEmail.description: Commit author email. Default: your GitHub no-reply address (always counts).

content.description: What each commit changes: single (one log file), daily (one file per day) or empty. Default: single.

contentPath.description: Log file (single) or folder (daily). Default: activity.log / activity.

readme.description: Add a README.md in the first commit: true, false or a path to your own. Default: true.

owner.description: Create the repository in this organization instead of your account.

branch.description: Branch to write (must be the default branch to count). Default: main.

ifExists.description: When the repository already has commits: fail, append (add on top) or replace (overwrite). Default: fail.

push.description: Push to GitHub. false = only create the local repository.

output.description: Keep the generated repository in this directory.

remote.description: Push to this existing git remote URL instead of creating a GitHub repository.

protocol.description: How to push to GitHub: https (token) or ssh (your SSH keys). Default: https.

host.description: GitHub host (for GitHub Enterprise Server). Default: github.com.

apiUrl.description: GitHub API URL (for GitHub Enterprise Server).
